hero.title: Teamwork
hero.pickTask: Start a timer on a task below
hero.notConfiguredDetail: Add your Teamwork site and API key in Settings to start tracking time.
hero.reconnectDetail: Reconnect: enter the API key for this site in Settings. Your key is only sent to the site it was saved for.
discard.confirm: Discard this timer without logging its time?
form.timerGone: That timer is no longer in Teamwork, so nothing was logged or discarded.
tasks.empty: No open tasks assigned to you.
tasks.noMatch: Nothing here matches. Press Enter to search Teamwork.

tasks.more.one: %1 more task. Type to narrow the list.
tasks.more.other: %1 more tasks. Type to narrow the list.

error.auth: Teamwork rejected the API key. Check Settings.
error.config: Check the site URL in Settings.
error.siteMismatch: Reconnect: enter the API key for this site in Settings.
settings.title: Settings
settings.siteHelp: Enter your Teamwork address, https://<yours>.teamwork.com, then paste your API key below and press Connect.
settings.keySavedFile: Saved to a private file (no keyring)
settings.keyReconnect: Reconnect: enter the API key for this site
settings.keyRemoveFailed: The API key couldn't be removed; it's still saved. Try again.
settings.keyRemoveUnavailable: The keyring couldn't be reached, so the API key may still be saved there. Unlock the keyring and try again.
settings.keyRejected: Teamwork rejected that key. Nothing was saved.
settings.keyInvalid: That doesn't look like a Teamwork API key. Nothing was saved.
settings.keyNeedsSite: Enter your site URL above first.
settings.keyHelp: In Teamwork: your profile, Edit my details, API & Mobile. Connect checks the key with the site above, saves that site, and keeps the key in the keyring, tied to that site: it is never sent to another site or written to shell.json.
settings.endBeforeStart: Work must end after it starts.
settings.lunchOrder: Lunch must end after it starts.
settings.nag: Nag when no timer is running
settings.longTimer: Warn when a timer passes (hours, 0 = off)
settings.afterHours: Warn at lunch and after hours
settings.afterHoursDesc: Once a day each, when a timer is still running at lunch or the end of the day.
settings.sortFieldHelp: The name of a Teamwork task custom field, any case. Its value shows as a badge on each task, and tasks whose value starts with a number (1st, 2, #3) sort first in their group, lowest first. Leave empty to turn it off.
notify.nagBody: It's work time and nothing is being tracked.
notify.afterBody: %1 is still timing past the end of your work day.
